title: Basis on Which a Challenged Amount Is Fixed on a Car Rental
content:
The amount put in dispute is the amount open to challenge on the damage recharged, less the part the
renter's own travel protection answers, taken at the share the timing of the assessment leaves open, with
the cleaning and fuel the renter also challenges added; it is never less than nothing and is rounded to two
decimal places once, on the final figure. This is the basis applied across the Car Rental Rate Classes.

## The parts of the amount

1. **The amount open to challenge.** The amount open to challenge is the whole of what the ledger carries as
   recharged damage on the rental.
2. **The part travel protection answers.** No part of the amount open to challenge is answered by travel
   protection. What the policy answers is taken off the amount open to challenge, and the remainder is never
   less than nothing.
3. **The days of the window used.** The days of the window used are the calendar days from the date the
   renter returned the vehicle to the date the rental desk decided the last damage assessment it approved on
   the rental.
4. **The share the timing leaves open.** The share the timing leaves open is 60 per cent.
5. **Cleaning.** Nothing is added for cleaning.
6. **Fuel.** Nothing is added for fuel.

The order is the order in which the figure is built: the amount open to challenge first, then the part
travel protection answers taken off it with a floor at nothing, then the share of what remains, and last
the cleaning and fuel amounts, which are added to the shared figure before the single rounding, with the
whole held at nothing or above.

## A challenged amount worked through on hypothetical figures

A hypothetical rental whose ledger carries recharged damage of 800 USD, the damage having been decided
3 calendar days after the vehicle came back.

- The amount open to challenge is 800 USD.
- Nothing is answered by travel protection, so 800 USD remains, which is not below nothing.
- The share the timing leaves open is 60 per cent of 800 USD, which is 480 USD.
- Nothing is added for cleaning and nothing for fuel.
- Rounded once on the final figure, the amount put in dispute is 480.00 USD.
